ABOUT NICK / OWNER & ELECTRICIAN

Hi, I’m Nick.
Your local electrician.

I’m Nick, a New Jersey licensed electrical contractor and the owner of Power Ranger Electric.

I’ve spent more than a decade installing electrical systems, tracking down faults, and maintaining the equipment that keeps buildings running.

I’ve learned to take the time to understand a problem before jumping into a repair. When I’m working in your home, I’ll explain what I find and talk through the next step with you.

SKILLS BUILT THROUGH HANDS-ON WORK

What I bring
to the job.

These are the skills I use to figure out what a job needs and see it through.

01

Electrical installation

I’ve run conduit and wiring, installed supports, and connected circuits and equipment. I plan the layout with future access and maintenance in mind.

02

Troubleshooting & repair

I use testing and measurements to find out what’s causing a fault, then explain what needs repairing and why.

03

Equipment & building systems

My maintenance experience includes lighting, controls, pumps, and other building equipment. It helps me understand how an electrical fault can affect the rest of a system.

04

Practical fabrication

I’ve built supports and mounts and worked out equipment layouts in tight spaces. Existing buildings often take some thought to get the fit right.

05

Planning & coordination

I work out the materials, access, and order of the job ahead of time, including any power interruptions we need to plan around.

06

Documentation & communication

I keep track of circuit and equipment details and explain the work that’s been done, so you have something useful to refer back to.

THE IDEA BEHIND POWER RANGER ELECTRIC

It’s your home.
I respect that.

I started Power Ranger Electric to put my experience into a business of my own. I want you to know who you’re hiring and feel comfortable picking up the phone when you need electrical work.

That means explaining the job, looking after the space I’m working in, and keeping you informed along the way.

Always PREpared. Always reliable.
